description: This file is a build recipe or configuration script for building the Rust compiler and runtime libraries within a Yocto/OpenEmbedded build system. It includes dependencies, environment setup, build, install, and configuration functions specific to Rust.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment by generating a 'config.toml' file with build parameters for Rust, including target, compiler, and installation paths.

methods.name: do_rust_setup_snapshot
methods.description: Sets up the Rust snapshot environment, including installing components and adjusting library paths, with optional uninative loader patching.

methods.name: rust_runx
methods.description: Runs the Rust build process, unsetting environment variables and invoking the bootstrap script with verbose output.

methods.name: rust_do_install
methods.description: Installs the built Rust binaries and libraries into the designated directories.

methods.name: rust_install_targets
methods.description: Installs custom target JSON files for Rust.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Performs installation of Rust components and target files.

methods.name: setup_cargo_environment
methods.description: Sets up the cargo build environment by configuring target-specific settings.
